capabilities: Run command palette commands automatically on vault startup
Filter commands to desktop, mobile, or all devices
Set initial and per-command delays before execution
Reorder and test individual commands or the full sequence
Toggle startup notifications and debug console logging
extras: README notes a command palette action for manually running the whole startup sequence without restarting, and that failed commands are error-isolated so remaining ones still run.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run commands automatically at startup, so users must manually re-trigger plugin and workspace setup commands every time they open the vault.
summary: Startup automation plugin that runs a configurable sequence of command palette commands automatically when a vault opens, with ordering, delays, and platform filters.
